# 20_commit_code.sh - Commit the deposit or other files

## Description

Commits a path to the repository.

1. Adds and commits the given path (paths under `generated/` are added with `-f`, as `generated/` may be ignored). The commit is logged to `generated/git-commit.log`.
2. Without a second argument, the commit message is "Adding code from <path>" and the commit gets an annotated tag `update<N>`, where N is one more than the highest existing `update` tag.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/20_commit_code.sh <path> [run|notag]
```

- `path` - What to commit, usually the deposit directory or `config.yml`. The ingest pipelines also call it separately for `generated/dot-ignore-local` and `.gitignore` (see [apply_ignore_local.sh](#help-apply_ignore_local)).
- `run` - Commit message "Attempted run <date>", no tag. Used after running author code.
- Any other second argument (the pipelines use `notag`) - Commit without a tag.

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `jiraticket` - When set, commit messages start with `<jiraticket> #comment [skip ci]`; otherwise with `[skip ci]`.
